chars.HAMID: HAMID: a 28-year-old Moroccan man with short curly black hair and light stubble, wearing a mustard-yellow hoodie with one wide red stripe across the chest and black jogging trousers
chars.GIULIA: GIULIA: a young Italian woman with long wavy blonde hair, wearing a long-sleeved pink satin pajama set with white piping
chars.FRIENDS: FRIENDS: two young Italian women, one with a black bob haircut in a long-sleeved green striped pajama, one with a red ponytail in a long-sleeved lavender pajama

scenes.name: n1.png
scenes.scene: HAMID sits nervously on the rug in a circle with GIULIA and FRIENDS in a cozy Italian apartment bedroom at night with warm fairy lights, a bed and a rug; the girls lean toward him laughing and teasing, he forces an awkward smile. No text anywhere in the image. 2D cartoon illustration.

scenes.name: n2.png
